hits.snippet: ### Key Facts 1. 1Jim Filter, a 27-year Schneider veteran, becomes president and CEO on July 1, 2026, succeeding Mark Rourke, who transitions to executive chairman. 2. 2Michael Baumgardt, a 23-year company executive, was named EVP of intermodal and logistics, a unit that generated $2.4 billion in combined revenue over the last 12 months. 3. 3Steve Wells, president of Cowan Systems since its acquisition in November 2024, was appointed EVP of truckload, which produced $2.5 billion in revenue in the past year. 4. 4Angela Prill, a 16-year Schneider employee, was promoted to senior vice president of intermodal operations, rounding out the new leadership team. 5. 5The intermodal, logistics, and truckload segments together account for approximately $4.9 billion in annual revenue, reflecting the scope of the leadership transition. 6. 6Schneider acquired dedicated contract carrier Cowan Systems in November 2024, and Wells's elevation integrates that asset into the truckload leadership structure.
